name: Remnant
overview: The concept of the remnant in Scripture reveals God's faithfulness in preserving a faithful group despite widespread judgment and apostasy. Isaiah 1:9 and Micah 2:12 show that God intentionally leaves and gathers a small, chosen portion of His people, likened to a flock protected and assembled by Him. Paul affirms in Romans 9:27 and 11:5 that this remnant is saved by God's grace and election, underscoring that God has not rejected His people (Romans 11:1). Finally, Revelation 12:17 describes the remnant as those who remain obedient to God's commandments and bear witness to Jesus Christ, highlighting their enduring spiritual commitment amid opposition.
